name: context7
description: Fetch up-to-date library documentation from Context7 by searching library ids and querying documentation context.
promptDescription: Fetch up-to-date library/API documentation from Context7. Required [action] chooses search or docs. For [action]: search, provide required [libraryName] and [query] to find Context7-compatible library ids. For [action]: docs, provide required [libraryId] such as /vercel/next.js or /facebook/react and required [query] to retrieve documentation snippets. Optional [fast] skips reranking for lower latency. Optional [timeoutMs] controls request timeout. Optional [maxOutputChars] controls markdown output length. Optional [description] records why the lookup is being run. API keys should be configured in tool user config or CONTEXT7_API_KEY, not placed in prompts. The tool returns normalized markdown plus metadata including action, query, statusCode, durationMs, truncated, and result counts.

context7ApiKey.title: Context7 API Key
context7ApiKey.description: Context7 API Key；也可通过 CONTEXT7_API_KEY 环境变量提供。未配置时使用 Context7 匿名访问能力，限额较低。

timeoutMs.title: 默认超时（毫秒）
timeoutMs.description: 模型未指定 timeoutMs 时使用的请求超时。

maxOutputChars.title: 默认最大输出字符数
maxOutputChars.description: 模型未指定 maxOutputChars 时使用的最大 Markdown 输出字符数。

fast.title: 默认快速模式
fast.description: 模型未指定 fast 时是否跳过 Context7 的重排序以降低延迟。

action.description: Action to run. Use search to find library ids; use docs to fetch documentation for a known library id.

libraryName.description: Context7 library name to search for, for example react, nextjs, prisma. Required for action=search.

libraryId.description: Context7-compatible library id, for example /facebook/react or /vercel/next.js. Required for action=docs.

fast.description: Skip Context7 reranking for lower latency.

description.description: Short human-readable reason for running the lookup.
